_comment: GeoFabrics 1.1.30 RiverBathymetryGenerator for one main channel, merged over the product's 'default' block (without its DEM outputs, extents and land) and run as its own runner call by terrain_s2.stage1.rivers. Parameters from GeoFabrics' Waikanae tests, scaled down for smaller channels; profile rivers.parameters overrides any of them. Width, bank and corridor settings are channel-specific: W7 tunes them.
